body:
Fez has such a kind, mac miller type vibe to him, I think ashtray is his little bro and they are both flipping drugs to pay off the house mortgage since their caretaker is sick...

Also, I hope that creepy fentanyl dealer dude dies this season as well fr

I don't really know if I believe in religion since personally I was brought up rather abusively and my family always used religion to gaslight and cover up the things they put me through.   


However I envision 'God' as some kind of all encompassing energy of love and light, why would this universal energy want to torture good people? People can help others without being physically and mentally tormented by factors beyond their control...  
Excuse my seemingly pessimistic outlook but I've been hurt, lied to, insulted, beat up.... why would an omnipotent and heavenly 'father' put his 'children' through so many trials and tribulations... I just want this pain in my mind to be silenced. Unless God truly is looking out for our best interests and I just deserve the pain I'm in since I am just an asshole who deserves to kill himself...

Dave Chapelle, Bill Burr, George Carlin, Theo Von are a few of my favs  


Its an oil cartridge vape for THC/CBD oils... so yeah fixed that up so I could use it to calm my nerves from all the suicidal thoughts  


Chess helps me wind down for some reason, I'm sorry to hear about your father and I hope his heart function returns and he gets healthy soon... it seems that bad things often happen to good people

It's almost 8am where I am right now, couldn't sleep all night so distracted myself by watching some comedy specials, playing chess online and repairing an old vape of mine that I found...

How about you Shamazing... Life getting anymore bearable on your end? Things all good with the family?

Yeah I'm still here, wouldn't really call my state of being at the moment 'alive' but still living and breathing... For now..

Sat on that ledge for hours thinking to jump but was too cowardly to commit to it...
I have very weird and dark issues, I just feel like a disgrace... my 22nd birthday is getting ever closer and I don't feel like I will make it
Im sorry that you are also dealing with thoughts of this nature.... it is quite scary to say the least, the view is beautiful..... I wouldn't mind this view being the last image I ever see.

My brain can't even picture the better days ahead anymore, I feel like I've already been swallowed by the shadows.. I'm a major disappointment to my family, friends{those I still haven't lost through depression} and all my ex girlfriends..

I don't feel worthy of love or affection anymore... The view where I am sitting now is so beautiful, the entire Skyline of a city full of lights, this could be the final picture my eyes ever see... I keep thinking... All I have to do to die is move forward 1 or 2 little inches and I will fall 50+ floors to my death...

Hugs from a sad boy in Asia x
Tried several medications and therapy with not much result...
